entities.name: Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Abd Allah ibn al-Zubayr ibn al-Awwam was the leader of a caliphate based in Mecca in opposition to the Umayyads during the Second Fitna from 683 until his death in 692.
